_comment: Content for the whole site. To add a course or note, edit this file. Dates are ISO (YYYY-MM-DD) so they sort as plain strings. LATER: a backend/admin panel would generate this from a database instead of a hand-edited file.

courses.name: Data Structures & Algorithms
courses.description: Arrays, linked lists, trees, graphs, hashing, sorting, and how to reason about time and space complexity.

notes.title: Arrays, lists & amortized analysis
notes.description: Dynamic arrays, why doubling gives O(1) amortized append, and linked-list trade-offs.

notes.title: Hash tables
notes.description: Hash functions, chaining vs open addressing, load factor and resizing.

notes.title: Problem set 1 — worked solutions
notes.description: Fully worked answers for PS1, including the two-pointer and sliding window questions.

courses.name: Operating Systems
courses.description: Processes and threads, scheduling, memory management, file systems, and the kernel/user boundary.

notes.title: Processes & threads
notes.description: Process lifecycle, context switches, and what a thread actually shares with its siblings.

notes.title: CPU scheduling cheat-sheet
notes.description: FCFS, SJF, round robin, and MLFQ on one page with worked Gantt charts.

courses.name: Databases
courses.description: The relational model, SQL, normalization, indexing, and transactions.

notes.title: The relational model
notes.description: Relations, keys, and the vocabulary you need before writing any SQL.

notes.title: SQL joins, visually
notes.description: Inner, left, right, and full outer joins with Venn diagrams and example queries.
